description: This source file defines the CachingHealthRoute class, which provides an Akka HTTP route for the '/health' endpoint. It manages caching of health status data, refreshes it periodically, and generates HTTP responses based on health status.

classes.name: CachingHealthRoute
classes.description: A final class responsible for creating and managing an Akka HTTP route at '/health' that reports system health status, with caching and refresh interval logic.

methods.name: CachingHealthRoute(final StatusAndHealthProvider, final Duration)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the route with a health provider and refresh interval.

methods.name: CachingHealthRoute(final StatusAndHealthProvider, final PublicHealthConfig)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the route using configuration object for cache timeout.

methods.name: buildHealthRoute
methods.description: Builds and returns the Akka HTTP Route for the '/health' endpoint.

methods.name: isCacheTimedOut
methods.description: Checks whether the cached health status has expired based on the refresh interval.

methods.name: createOverallHealthResponse
methods.description: Generates the HTTP response for the '/health' endpoint, utilizing cached data or retrieving fresh status as needed.
